title: LINK optimization of FAST_TDA two-photon strength
summary: Maximize a closed-shell FAST_TDA degenerate two-photon strength with its analytic global-adjoint Cartesian gradient and a certified LINK coordinate chart.
gates: fixed selected-space policy within every derivative evaluation
SYCART or SONIC coordinate model supplied by LINK
coordinate_policy: LINK consumes the supplied nonredundant symmetry-adapted coordinate chart; raw Cartesian optimizer variables are forbidden.
backend_policy: FAST_TDA remains resident and the minimized scalar is the negative isotropic two-photon strength.
